description: One search over docs, wiki and mail, by relevance. Operators apply per source; operators, warnings and skipped report it. define:<term> also returns definition (as search_docs).

query.description: Words or a question. Operators apply where they fit: after:/before:, site:docs|wiki|mail|commits, intitle:, from:, link:<url glob>, /regex/

name: search_all_sources
